name: Sword of Wonder: It's Good to be a King
source:
Sword of Wonder: It's Good to be a King, is a visual adventure for a mature audience. You are a shipwrecked merchant, struggling through the rain...until you meet the Lady. Your life is twisted into a tornado of torrid adventures and familiar moments that you must choose a path to get through. You find yourself a perfectly good sword that's been brutally driven into a stone of all things. There loss is your gain, I suppose, and you could possibly use this to your advantage being such a familiar story and all. After you become better equipped and set out to carve yourself a kingdom in a foreign land, it could be something happens in the forest...or not.

Guide yourself through this fantasy tale and keep that sword up and ready. You will need to mount every challenge thrown your way, and prove you are worthy of victory.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2204030/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《奇迹之剑：成为国王真好》是一款适合成熟观众的视觉冒险游戏。你是一个遭遇海难的商人，在雨中挣扎……直到你遇到了那位女士。你的生活被扭曲成一场由炎热的冒险和熟悉的时刻组成的龙卷风，你必须选择一条路来度过。你发现自己是一把完美的剑，被残酷地插进了万物的石头中。我想，有损失就有收获，而且你可能会利用这一点来获得优势，因为这是一个如此熟悉的故事等等。当你装备得更好并开始在异国他乡建立一个王国后，森林里可能会发生一些事情……也可能不会。

引导自己完成这个奇幻故事，并准备好剑。你需要迎接每一个挑战，并证明你值得胜利。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2204030/]Steam[/url]]
